name: Strike
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished illustration for the fantasy deckbuilding game Panlibrarium, card STRIKE. Subject: a steel short sword with an ivory quill-shaped guard slashing through a ribbon of living midnight-blue ink in an ancient library; a sharp diagonal action, torn parchment leaves caught in its wake. Painterly dark fantasy book illustration, tangible oil and gouache brushwork, aged brass, bone parchment, deep indigo, restrained warm amber rim light, dramatic chiaroscuro. Distinct focal silhouette, readable at thumbnail size. Landscape 3:2 composition, central action stays in middle 70% for responsive cropping, atmospheric depth. Full-bleed artwork only, no card frame, no text, no letters, no symbols as typography, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no watermark. No cartoon icon, no flat vector look, no gore. This is a new standalone artwork, not a card mockup.
